entity.name: Shreyansh Sancheti
entity.description: I build and maintain Clawdlinux (agentic-operator-core), an open-source Kubernetes operator for governing AI agent workloads in air-gapped and enterprise environments: gVisor sandboxing, Cilium egress policy, hash-chained audit logging, and FinOps controls. I also maintain agent-native-format (ANF/ACP), a token-minimal governed execution format for agent tool calls.
